name: Play Ten Songs with Two Easy Chords
instructions: Real songs often repeat the same 2-3 chords throughout -- today puts your two chords from this week to immediate use.
Play along slowly at first, prioritizing clean chord changes over matching the original tempo exactly.
Notice how the same two chords sound completely different across different songs, depending on rhythm and strumming pattern.
Watch today's video for ten real songs built on just two chords.
